scope: Static re-expression of passing audited evidence; no model execution

figures.caption: Tuning fidelity/cost tradeoff for all 36 arm/configuration cells. Budget colors join four efSearch settings; marker shapes identify efSearch values. Filled points require both macro greedy agreement >=99.5% and top-50 probability-mass recall >=99%; hollow points fail at least one screen. Exact-head timing is newly measured on the same host. Lines only connect registered settings; there is no fitted curve or extrapolation. These are descriptive means over correlated contexts, not confidence bounds.

Confirmation complete cached-decode and directly measured prefill-plus-decode latency for exact scoring and each arm's tune-only frozen setting. The selected configuration is diagnostic when no tuning cell passes both fidelity screens; a confirmation result cannot retrospectively promote it. Hatched bars denote paths ineligible for a matched-fidelity win. Short dashed ticks in the cached-decode panel mark 10% below that arm's own exact latency; the combined-request panel is a separate secondary measurement. No uncertainty intervals or cross-seed serving claims are implied.
